Method of Attack: Malware installers disguised as fake Google Chrome updates that drop TeamViewer installation and password-protected SFX archives containing files to open fake update page and allow remote connections, plus a script to bypass Windows antivirus
Attack Vector: Malware delivery through Bitbucket repository hosting the malicious installers
Indicators of Compromise: Downloads of Critical_Update.exe (2290+ times) and Update.exe (300+ times) from Bitbucket repository
Valid digital signature identical to fake NordVPN installer
Use of password-protected SFX archives and TeamViewer installation
